data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'land', meaning 'to rest', 'to be at ease'. In Islamic tradition, Landa signifies the tranquility and grace bestowed by Allah upon His beloved creatures. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Landa usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
